The team was led by third-year head coach [[Andy Kennedy]], and played their home games at the [[Bartow Arena]] in [[Birmingham, Alabama]] as a member of [[Conference USA]]. The season marked the team's last season as members of Conference USA before joining the [[American Athletic Conference]] on July 1, 2023.{{cite news |url=https://uabsports.com/news/2022/6/15/general-uab-to-officially-join-american-athletic-conference-on-july-1-2023 |title=UAB to Officially Join American Athletic Conference on July 1, 2023 |publisher=UAB Blazers Athletics |date=2012-10-16 |accessdate=2022-06-10}} ==Previous season== The [[2021–22 UAB Blazers men's basketball team|Blazers]] finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 27–8, 14–4 in [[2021–22 Conference USA men's basketball season|C-USA]] play to finish second in the West Division. As the No. 2 seed out of the West Division, they defeated [[2021–22 Florida Atlantic Owls men's basketball team|Florida Atlantic]], [[2021–22 Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders men's basketball team|Middle Tennessee]], and [[2021–22 Louisiana Tech Bulldogs basketball team|Louisiana Tech]] to win the [[2022 Conference USA men's basketball tournament|C-USA tournament]]. They received the conference's automatic bid to the [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 12 seed in the South Region, where they lost in the first round to [[2021–22 Houston Cougars men's basketball team|Houston]]. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
